plugins.name: CRT
plugins.description: A phosphor green theme with scanlines and a soft glow over the terminals. Turn it off by disabling the plugin.
plugins.author: Lumen

plugins.name: Pomodoro
plugins.description: A 25/5 focus timer in the top bar. Click it to start or pause; a toast tells you when to take a break.
plugins.author: Lumen

plugins.name: Todo
plugins.description: A small todo list per project, in the sidebar. It follows the focused terminal: each folder has its own list, which follows you into its subfolders.
plugins.author: Lumen

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.description: The current temperature in the top bar, from wttr.in (your location is guessed from your IP). Click it for the full forecast.
plugins.author: Lumen
